LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.Settings.NumericGroupDesc: Bonus curves for the six attributes
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.Settings.GuildContentDesc: Guild envoys and guild quests are still in development and may be incomplete or hurt the experience. Enable to turn them on; when disabled, no new guild quest or envoy is sent, quests already accepted finish naturally, and familia rank and upgrade points are kept.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.Settings.CurveHint: A raw attribute value is mapped through the curve to the effective value used for bonus calculation.\nThe horizontal axis is the raw value and the vertical axis the effective value. Drag to move, double-click to add, right-click to delete.\n<color=#FF7373>Note: values that are too high may unbalance the game experience</color>
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.Settings.DecayGroupDesc: Customize the growth decay values;\n<color=#FF7373>Note: too low a decay may unbalance the game experience</color>
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.Settings.DecayStatThresholdD: Decay begins once the value (single attribute) exceeds this threshold; below it growth stays linear.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.Settings.DecayTotalThreshold: Decay begins once the value (six-attribute total) exceeds this threshold; below it growth stays linear.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.Settings.DecayStatPeakRateDe: Decay rate at the per-level cap of the value (single attribute); 0% means no decay.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.Settings.DecayTotalPeakRateD: Decay rate at the per-level cap of the value (six-attribute total); 0% means no decay.
